keyPoints.en: Prefixes change meaning: un-, dis-, im-, ir-, il- (negative), re- (again), pre- (before).
keyPoints.bm: Awalan mengubah makna: un-, dis-, im-, ir-, il- (negatif), re- (semula), pre- (sebelum).
Akhiran mengubah golongan kata: -tion/-ness (kata nama), -ful/-ous (adjektif), -ly (adverba), -ise/-en (kata kerja).

keyPoints.en: Look at the position in the sentence to choose the right form.
keyPoints.bm: Lihat kedudukan dalam ayat untuk memilih bentuk yang betul.

keyPoints.en: make: a mistake, a decision. do: homework, research. take: a photo, a break.
keyPoints.bm: make: a mistake, a decision. do: homework, research. take: a photo, a break.

keyPoints.en: Adjective collocations: heavy rain, strong coffee, high temperature.
keyPoints.bm: Kolokasi adjektif: heavy rain, strong coffee, high temperature.

keyPoints.en: Phrasal verbs: give up, put off, turn down, come across, run out of, look after.
keyPoints.bm: Kata kerja frasa: give up, put off, turn down, come across, run out of, look after.

tip.en: Learn words in pairs (collocations), not alone — your writing will sound natural.
tip.bm: Belajar perkataan secara berpasangan (kolokasi), bukan bersendirian — penulisan akan kedengaran lebih asli.

keyPoints.en: Idioms: a piece of cake (easy), break the ice, once in a blue moon (rarely), under the weather (unwell).
keyPoints.bm: Simpulan bahasa: a piece of cake (mudah), break the ice, once in a blue moon (jarang), under the weather (kurang sihat).

keyPoints.en: Confused words: affect/effect, advice/advise, lose/loose, their/there/they're, its/it's.
keyPoints.bm: Perkataan keliru: affect/effect, advice/advise, lose/loose, their/there/they're, its/it's.

keyPoints.en: Uncountable nouns have no plural: information, advice, furniture, equipment.
keyPoints.bm: Kata nama tak boleh dikira tiada bentuk jamak: information, advice, furniture, equipment.
